name: Enkyori Ren'ai
storyline:
​​You possess a mysterious ability to see and sever other people's ties, and you share a secret with Tsumugi, a womanizing scumbag. While playing with Tsumugi, you sever other people's ties and forge your own.

Enjoy a heartwarming life of severing ties (a romantic comedy with a touch of obsessive love and yandere). May your bad ties be severed and good ties be blessed.
summary: An otome game where you’re swept off your feet and become entangled with an obsessive scumbag who deeply cherishes you.
